headlines.headline: Moody's Ratings Reaffirms AFFIN Group's A3 Long-Term Credit Rating
headlines.summary: Moody's Ratings has maintained the A3 long-term credit rating for Malaysia's AFFIN Group, citing the banking group's solid standalone creditworthiness and support from its major shareholder, the Sarawak government.

headlines.headline: Incyte's Povorcitinib Enters Phase III Clinical Trial in China for Non-Segmental Vitiligo
headlines.summary: Incyte's partner, Dermavon, has initiated a Phase III clinical trial in China to evaluate the efficacy and safety of the oral JAK1 inhibitor povorcitinib in adult patients with non-segmental vitiligo.

headlines.headline: BofA Securities Adjusts Best Buy Outlook Amid Sales Momentum and Margin Concerns
headlines.summary: BofA Securities raised its comparable sales estimates for Best Buy while cautioning that rising memory costs could pressure margins.

headlines.headline: FERC Approves Cheniere Energy's Sabine Pass Expansion
headlines.summary: The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission has approved the construction of three new liquefaction trains at Cheniere Energy's Sabine Pass terminal.

headlines.headline: Leerink Partners Maintains Buy Rating on CVS Health
headlines.summary: Leerink Partners analyst Michael Cherny has reiterated a 'Buy' rating and a $104 price target for CVS Health.

headlines.headline: Genesis Molecular AI Reports Performance Gains in Incyte Collaboration Programs
headlines.summary: Genesis Molecular AI released a technical report highlighting the performance of its 'Ruby' AI model, which demonstrated high accuracy in predicting small-molecule potency using data from its collaboration with Incyte.

headlines.headline: Mizuho Securities Raises Incyte Price Target to $148
headlines.summary: Mizuho Securities has increased its price target for Incyte Corporation from $137 to $148 while maintaining an 'Outperform' rating.

headlines.headline: UGG Partners with Bloomingdale's and Forty Carrots for Holiday 'UGG Parlor' Activation
headlines.summary: Deckers Brands' UGG division has launched a holiday partnership with Bloomingdale's and Forty Carrots, featuring exclusive frozen yogurt flavors and in-store activations.

headlines.headline: The New York Times Announces Staff Updates for Audience Team and Magazine
headlines.summary: The New York Times Company has announced new leadership and staff appointments within its Audience team and The New York Times Magazine.

headlines.headline: EMCOR Group, Inc. Announces Participation in Upcoming Investor Event
headlines.summary: EMCOR Group, Inc. announced that its senior leadership team, including CEO Tony Guzzi and CFO Jason Nalbandian, will participate in the UBS Global Industrials and Transportation Conference 2026.

headlines.headline: CVS Health Announces Winners of Inaugural Home Team Heroes Youth Soccer Contest
headlines.summary: CVS Health has named the grand prize winners of its first Home Team Heroes youth soccer contest, which recognizes young athletes for their community impact.

headlines.headline: Walmart Canada Raises Over $3.9 Million for Canadian Red Cross
headlines.summary: Walmart Canada announced that its annual fundraising campaign, supported by a $1 million kick-off donation, raised over $3.9 million for the Canadian Red Cross.

headlines.headline: Analysts Adjust Price Targets for Walmart Inc.
headlines.summary: Several financial institutions, including Morgan Stanley, KeyBanc, and Raymond James, updated their price targets for Walmart Inc. on November 20, 2026.

headlines.headline: BofA Securities Adjusts Best Buy Price Target to $83 From $80
headlines.summary: BofA Securities has updated its price target for Best Buy Co., Inc. while maintaining an Underperform rating.

headlines.headline: JPMorgan Lowers Price Target for SMG Swiss Marketplace Group
headlines.summary: JPMorgan has issued a price target reduction for SMG Swiss Marketplace Group, contributing to a decline in the company's share price.

headlines.headline: Apple Developer Academy Showcase in Pohang
headlines.summary: Apple held its annual showcase for the Apple Developer Academy in Pohang, South Korea, featuring apps developed by students.

headlines.headline: Apple Developing Autonomous AI Agent
headlines.summary: Apple is reportedly developing an autonomous AI agent capable of performing multistep tasks, including writing code, browsing the web, and controlling applications.

headlines.headline: Baird Downgrades Fastenal to Neutral
headlines.summary: Baird has downgraded Fastenal Company to a neutral rating with a price target of $56.

headlines.headline: CVS Health Mentioned in Context of Proposed CMS 'CRUSH' Rule
headlines.summary: CVS Health is identified as a major managed care company affected by the newly proposed CMS-6098-P rule regarding Medicare Advantage audits.

headlines.headline: Belden Declares Quarterly Dividend of $0.05 Per Share
headlines.summary: Belden Inc. has declared a quarterly dividend of $0.05 per share, payable on January 7, 2027, to shareholders of record as of December 10, 2026.

headlines.headline: Belden Launches New Products and Portfolio Updates to Strengthen OT Resiliency
headlines.summary: Belden Inc. has introduced new products and portfolio updates aimed at enhancing operational technology (OT) network resilience across industrial environments.

headlines.headline: The Boston Beer Company Names Phil Hodges President and Chief Executive Officer
headlines.summary: The Boston Beer Company has appointed current COO Phil Hodges as its new President and CEO, effective November 23, 2026, succeeding founder Jim Koch.

headlines.headline: Domino's Renews $1 Million Partnership with GENYOUth to Combat Student Hunger
headlines.summary: Domino's has announced a renewed three-year, $1 million commitment to the national nonprofit GENYOUth to support school meal access and address student food insecurity.

headlines.headline: U.K. Tribunal Orders Government to Confirm Secret Demand for Apple Customer Data
headlines.summary: The U.K. Investigatory Powers Tribunal has ordered the government to confirm it issued a secret technical order requiring Apple to provide encrypted customer information.

headlines.headline: Apple Camera and Photos Software Chief Jon McCormack Departs
headlines.summary: Jon McCormack, the head of Apple's camera and photo software, has reportedly left the company.

headlines.headline: UBS Adjusts Gulfport Energy Price Target to $210 From $217, Maintains Buy Rating
headlines.summary: UBS has revised its price target for Gulfport Energy Corporation, lowering it to $210 from the previous $217 while maintaining a Buy rating.

headlines.headline: StoneX Initiates Coverage of Deckers Brands with Buy Rating
headlines.summary: Financial services firm StoneX has initiated coverage on Deckers Brands, assigning the stock a Buy rating with a price target of $110.

headlines.headline: Dogfish Head Releases 2026 Holiday Gift Guide
headlines.summary: The Boston Beer Company subsidiary Dogfish Head has announced its 2026 holiday gift lineup, featuring seasonal beers, spirits, and branded merchandise.

headlines.headline: UL Solutions R&D Engineer Wins 2026 CONVERGE CFD Conference Simulation Competition
headlines.summary: Patrick O'Donnell, an R&D Engineer at UL Solutions, received first place in the 'Most Innovative Use of CONVERGE' category for his work on battery energy storage system simulations.

headlines.headline: Innovative Eyewear's Lucyd Armor Smart Safety Glasses Receive UL Solutions Certification
headlines.summary: Innovative Eyewear, Inc. announced that its Lucyd Armor smart safety glasses have been certified as compliant with AS/NZS 1337.1 following testing by UL Solutions and Intertek.

headlines.headline: The Clorox Company Approves 2026 Annual Dividend
headlines.summary: At its annual meeting held on November 18, 2026, The Clorox Company approved an annual dividend of $4.97 per share for the 2026 fiscal year.

headlines.headline: The New York Times and PressReader Expand Strategic Partnership
headlines.summary: The New York Times Company and PressReader have announced an expansion of their strategic partnership, extending their agreement through 2031 and broadening the scope of content available to international institutional partners.

headlines.headline: CVS Health Expands Integrated Flu and COVID-19 Testing and Treatment Services
headlines.summary: CVS Health is offering a single-swab combination test for Influenza A, Influenza B, and COVID-19 at over 1,500 pharmacy locations, with integrated treatment options available in select states.

headlines.headline: Kroger and Michigan State Police Continue Annual Thanksgiving Meal Donation Partnership
headlines.summary: Kroger and the Michigan State Police have partnered for the 11th consecutive year to distribute Thanksgiving meal kits to families in Michigan.

headlines.headline: Report Alleges Presence of Toxic Heavy Metals in Baby Food Sold by Kroger and Harris Teeter
headlines.summary: A report by the CRFB alleges that baby food products sold at Kroger and its subsidiary Harris Teeter contain concerning levels of toxic heavy metals.

headlines.headline: Apple Announces 2026 Black Friday Shopping Event
headlines.summary: Apple has announced its annual Black Friday shopping event, scheduled for November 27 through November 30, 2026, featuring Apple Gift Cards of up to $300 with the purchase of eligible products.

headlines.headline: Garmin Signal VHF Named Overall Winner in 2026 DAME Design Awards
headlines.summary: Garmin's Signal VHF marine communication device has been recognized as the overall winner of the 2026 DAME Design Awards.

headlines.headline: Wattsipper by Summit Appliance Achieves UL 858 Certification for New 120V Induction Range Line
headlines.summary: Wattsipper, a division of Felix Storch, Inc., has received UL 858 certification for its new Contemporary Series of 120V battery-free induction ranges.

headlines.headline: Kestrel Labs Announces Integration with Autodesk Forma
headlines.summary: Kestrel Labs has integrated its BIM-native building code compliance platform with Autodesk Forma, enhancing automated compliance checks for users.

headlines.headline: Aetna Launches 'Aetna For You & Baby' Initiative

headlines.headline: RBC Raises Price Target on Cheniere Energy to $373 From $319
headlines.summary: RBC Capital Markets has increased its price target for Cheniere Energy, Inc. while maintaining an Outperform rating.

headlines.headline: Moody's Projects 2.3% U.S. Economic Growth for 2026
headlines.summary: Moody's released a forecast projecting 2.3% growth for the U.S. economy in 2026, with expectations of a slowdown in subsequent years.

headlines.headline: Argus Adjusts Price Target on Ralph Lauren to $415 From $400
headlines.summary: Investment research firm Argus has increased its price target for Ralph Lauren Corporation shares from $400 to $415.

headlines.headline: VeriSign Insider Sold Shares Worth $1,006,275
headlines.summary: A VeriSign insider has sold company shares valued at approximately $1.01 million, according to a recent SEC filing.

headlines.headline: Walmart Raises Fiscal Year Guidance Amid 3Q Earnings Beat
headlines.summary: Walmart reported fiscal third-quarter results that surpassed analyst expectations and increased its full-year earnings and sales growth outlook.

headlines.summary: Moody's Ratings has revised the outlook for Toyota Motor Corporation from stable to positive while affirming its A1 long-term and Prime-1 commercial paper ratings.

headlines.headline: Happy Cappy Medicated Shampoo & Body Wash Expands Distribution to Walmart Stores

headlines.headline: Incyte Insider Sold Shares Worth $319,588
headlines.summary: An insider at Incyte Corporation sold shares of the company's stock valued at $319,588, according to a recent SEC filing.

headlines.headline: EXL Named a Leader in Everest Group's 2026 Fraud Management Operations Services PEAK Matrix Assessment

headlines.headline: The Clorox Company Declares Regular Quarterly Dividend

headlines.headline: Match Group CFO to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences
headlines.summary: Match Group announced that CFO Steven Bailey will participate in fireside chats at the UBS Global Technology and AI Conference and the Nasdaq London Investor Conference in December 2026.

headlines.summary: Volar Avionics & Restorations, an FAA-accepted repair station, has been named a CubCrafters Authorized Service Center, expanding its capacity to provide maintenance and upgrades for Garmin avionics systems.

headlines.headline: Blue Bird Corporation to Report Fiscal 2026 Fourth Quarter and Full Year Results on December 2, 2026
headlines.summary: Blue Bird Corporation has scheduled the release of its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter and full year financial results for December 2, 2026.

headlines.headline: Adobe Connect and Adobe Video Display Receive 2026 Product of the Year Award
headlines.summary: Adobe Connect and Adobe Video Display were recognized as winners in the 2026 Product of the Year Awards by Campus Technology and THE Journal.

headlines.headline: Fly By Jing Launches Exclusive Hot Sauce Gift Set at Walmart
headlines.summary: Fly By Jing has introduced a new Hot Sauce Gift Set available exclusively at more than 2,000 Walmart stores nationwide.

headlines.headline: Apple Releases HomeView Software 27.2.1 Update
headlines.summary: Apple has issued a software update for its smart home hub to address Siri functionality and connectivity bugs.

headlines.headline: CVS Health Recognized for Contact Center Cloud Transformation
headlines.summary: CVS Health was named a winner of the 2026 New Era of CX Awards for its collaboration with Five9 to modernize its contact center infrastructure.

headlines.headline: Apple Announces Finalists for 2026 App Store Awards
headlines.summary: Apple has revealed the 45 finalists for its annual App Store Awards, recognizing excellence across its hardware ecosystem.

headlines.headline: CVS Health Shares Decline Amid Reports of Potential Medicare Advantage Reimbursement Changes
headlines.summary: CVS Health shares fell following reports of potential US government regulatory changes regarding Medicare Advantage reimbursement rates.

headlines.headline: Michael Burry Increases Stake in Adobe Inc.

headlines.headline: Linkind Expands Retail Presence at Best Buy

headlines.summary: Pediatric Solutions, LLC announced that its Happy Cappy Medicated Shampoo is now available in over 600 Walmart Neighborhood Market locations.
